description: Register a watch for SEC EDGAR filing alerts: a set of CIKs and/or tickers plus an optional form-type set. Paid via x402: $0.005 — RULED (5000 USDC units / 33500 SOL lamports). The $0.005 registration price is RULED (Mauricio, 2026-10-20) — the evaluation ladder figure, ruled as proposed. Always call the free preflight first (same body): POST /toll/secalerts/watch/preflight performs all validation, resolves tickers to CIKs, and returns the exact price ($0.005 — RULED) before any payment; an unresolvable ticker is a free unknown_ticker refusal, never a guess. Registration returns a watch_id (a bearer credential — possession IS read access to that watch's alerts view; there is no separate secret, no rotation, and no recovery for a lost watch_id) and its initial cursor: the watch reports only filings first seen after it was created. first_seen_at is ExchangeRebel's own detection timestamp — the moment this service first recorded the filing in its append-only store. The SEC publishes no availability timestamp, so no seller's first-seen time can be anything other than their own observation. For a filer's first-ever touch, the store is seeded from the filer's returned history and first_seen_at is the seed time (records carry seeded:true). You only pay for delivered answers — a registration that fails after settlement writes exactly one refund intent and creates no watch. Price: $0.005 per call (per watch registration). — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/secalerts/watch.

amendments_only.description: Optional, default false; filters filing events only, never deletion flags.

ciks.description: CIK strings, 1-10 digits each, at most 25 — provide ciks and/or tickers.

forms.description: Optional form strings, at most 20; omit for all forms. A filter matches the exact form or its base form (8-K matches 8-K and 8-K/A).

include_deletions.description: Optional, default false; deletion flags are produced only from records whose provenance marks them weekly-index-reconciliation-sourced.

tickers.description: Ticker symbols, at most 25, resolved to CIKs at registration.

name: sec_alerts_register_watch
